title: The Third Ledger
author: Bram Eriksen
blurb: Cyrus Villalobos, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
